data.q: Which keyword is used to declare a local variable with implicit type in C#?
data.e: The 'var' keyword allows the compiler to infer the type of the variable from the initialization expression.

data.q: What is the default value of an uninitialized int variable in C#?
data.e: Value types like int are automatically initialized to their default values (0 for numeric types) when declared as fields. Local variables must be explicitly initialized before use.

data.q: Which of the following is a value type in C#?
data.e: int is a value type (struct). string, object, and List<int> are reference types.

data.q: What is the size of a double data type in C#?
data.e: A double is a 64-bit (8-byte) floating-point type.

data.q: Which operator is used for null-coalescing in C#?
data.e: The ?? operator returns the left-hand operand if it is not null; otherwise it returns the right-hand operand.

data.q: What is the correct syntax for a multi-line comment in C#?
data.e: Multi-line comments are enclosed between /* and */. // is for single-line comments.

data.q: Which of the following is a reference type in C#?
data.e: class is a reference type. struct and enum are value types. byte is a value type (struct).

data.q: What is the range of the byte data type in C#?
data.e: byte is an unsigned 8-bit integer ranging from 0 to 255.

data.q: How do you declare a constant in C#?
data.e: The 'const' keyword declares a compile-time constant. 'readonly' is for runtime constants (fields only). 'final' is not a C# keyword.

data.q: Which of the following is NOT a C# keyword?
data.e: package is a Java keyword. C# uses 'namespace' for organizing code.

data.q: What is the result of the expression 5 / 2 when both operands are of type int?
data.e: Integer division truncates the fractional part, resulting in 2.

data.q: Which method is commonly used to convert a string to an integer in C#?
data.e: int.Parse() is the standard method. Convert.ToInt32() also works. The others are Java or invalid.

data.q: What is the default value of a bool variable (field) in C#?
data.e: The default value of a bool is false.

data.q: Which of the following declares a nullable integer in C#?
data.e: int? is syntactic sugar for Nullable<int>. Both declare a nullable value type.

data.q: What is the correct way to define a verbatim string literal that includes backslashes and line breaks?
data.e: The @ prefix creates a verbatim string literal where escape sequences are not processed, allowing literal backslashes and newlines.
